\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{Obs}{Observation}
\newtheorem{definition}{Definition}
\newenvironment{df}{\begin{definition}\rm}{\end{definition}}
\newenvironment{obs}{\begin{Obs}\rm}{\end{Obs}}
\begin{document}
% BUG-29: newenvironment lambda closure bug.
% \begin{df}...\end{df} should expand to \begin{definition}\rm...\end{definition}
% but instead expands to \begin{Obs}\rm...\end{Obs} (uses obs's begin/end).
% Root cause: line 423 of demacro.py:
%   content = lambda arg : begin(arg) + arg.group('between') + end(arg)
% Python closure captures 'begin' and 'end' by reference, not by value.
% After the loop processes 'obs', all earlier lambdas point to obs's begin/end.
\begin{df}This is a definition.\end{df}
\begin{obs}This is an observation.\end{obs}
\end{document}
